translation_snapshot.source: From the dust of decay a %s forms!
translation_snapshot.target: 一只%s从腐朽的尘埃中成形了！

translation_snapshot.source: %s raises %s %s, and a red light flashes from it's eye sockets!
translation_snapshot.target: %s 举起了%s%s，一道红光从它的眼窝中闪过！

translation_snapshot.source: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.
translation_snapshot.target: 永远在燃烧，永远在死去，永远在重生，凤凰向你俯冲而来，想让你分享它炽烈的命运。

translation_snapshot.source: #LIGHT_RED#A carrion worm mass has spawned from %s' wounds!
translation_snapshot.target: #LIGHT_RED#一个腐肉虫群从%s的伤口中孵化了出来！

translation_snapshot.source: #AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
translation_snapshot.target: #AQUAMARINE#当%s倒下时它所有的眼睛都掉落在了地上！

translation_snapshot.source: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
translation_snapshot.target: 法力蠕虫是以奥术使用者的法力值为食的洛斯格罗斯。如果它们近距离接触到施法者，就会缠上去吸干对方的法力值。
